scoring_justification: T1 recompute not feasible because only final computed numbers are produced; no intermediate raw data to recompute from. Using T0 result-level compare with paper-reported gold and relative tolerance 0.1% for deterministic analytic quantities.

hidden_assets.purpose: Embedded paper-reported gold values for the six computed parameters.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper IV. CALCULATION RESULTS: ℓ=140 μm, Δℓ=0.02 μm, U∼=40 V, Λ=1.6e-5 m, θ≈0.031, I_m/I_0≈0.063.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly transcribed from the paper's explicit numeric results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the published values the paper claims, used as the reproduction target.

outputs.description: Computed device parameters from material properties and operating conditions.

output_contract.notes: All six values must be computed and reported; the checker compares to the paper's reported values within a tolerance.

steps.description: Compare each of the six computed parameters to paper-reported gold with 0.1% relative tolerance; field-wise pass/fail.
